_comment: Tier-2 for kratos iga#: catalog listed 'SurfaceLoadCondition' as an IGA Element. It is (a) a Condition not an Element, and (b) needs a shape suffix (3D3N / 3D4N from StructuralMechanicsApplication). The bare-name 'SurfaceLoadCondition' fails CreateNewElement and CreateNewCondition with 'is not registered'. The Shell3p/5p elements work fine. Verified empirically 2026-06-01. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 gives the bare SurfaceLoadCondition name its 3D3N shape suffix in the condition probe, so it registers. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: base_name_as_condition_rejected=True, surface_load_3D3N_condition_ok=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/iga_surface_condition_naming && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
